Date: 09/05/2026
Patient Name: Paula Bennett
DOB: 05/09/1948
MRN: MRN-83585

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Alan Foster, Evergreen Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of fatigue in a 78-year-old woman with a strong family history of premature heart disease.

Paula Bennett is a 78-year-old woman with hypertension, type 2 diabetes, hypothyroidism, and osteoarthritis who reports persistent fatigue.

Several close relatives developed heart disease at a young age, and she is concerned about her own risk. Please assess her fatigue and family history of premature heart disease and advise on further evaluation.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Alan Foster
Evergreen Family Practice
